vocabulary.definition: of more than average height, especially in comparison with others
vocabulary.example: The Burj Khalifa in Dubai is the tallest building in the world.

vocabulary.definition: a part that is added to something to enlarge or prolong it
vocabulary.example: The extension of the singer building made it the tallest at that time.

vocabulary.definition: a continuous period of specified success or luck
vocabulary.example: New York City had a streak of holding height records for over 60 years.

vocabulary.definition: a name that describes someone's position or job
vocabulary.example: The Empire State Building held the title of the tallest building for 40 years.
The World Trade Center replaced the Empire State Building as the tallest building.

vocabulary.definition: a protective charm in the Harry Potter series
vocabulary.example: The Patronus Towers in Malaysia are named after a spell in Harry Potter.
